data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Arondas, meaning 'mountain' or 'strong'. In Greek mythology, Arondas was a hero who defended the people of Athens against an invading army. The name Arondel carries the symbolism of strength, courage, and protection. The name Arondel carries the meaning “Strong mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arondel usually hope their child will grow to embody strong mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
